plays.name: Starbucks
plays.title: January Calls on a Coffeehouse Turnaround
flow: Starbucks (SBUX) saw 7,500 January $105 calls bought, still in open interest from 7/31. 2,000 January 2028 $95 short puts opened, with 1,500 September $85 short puts and 1,500 September $95 short puts opening.

SBUX is a global coffeehouse operator with about 41,600 stores, North America about 80% of revenue, in a productivity-led turnaround: Q4 U.S. comps +7.7% with transaction growth, Rewards at a record 36 million 90-day actives, and more than half of a $2B gross savings program realized. Shares are up 26% year to date and are probing the $108 to $110 resistance that has capped the year. A move above targets the early-2025 $116 highs, and above about $112 is a trend inflection from the all-time highs. Valuation sits near the 50th percentile of its 10-year range. The desk leans with the longer-term put sellers and the January $105 call open interest on strength through $110 to $112. The reference price is about $107.
plays.recommendation: The desk wants SBUX through about $110–$112, with the turnaround comps, Rewards scale, and savings program as the hold.
